newsitem.title: USA: PECO completes buying Pennsylvania plant.
newsitem.headline: PECO completes buying Pennsylvania plant.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said Friday that it has finalized its purchase of USX Corp's power plant in Falls Township, Bucks County, Pennsylvania.
The deal includes a power house, two steam turbine generators, nearly 10-acres of land and a right-of-way that connects the plant with Waste Management Inc property, PECO said.
The plant will burn landfill gas, which is about 50 percent methane, from two nearby landfills owned by Waste Management.
PECO said two power plants will buy the gas produced from the burned waste and that it also will provide USX with steam from the facility.
Peco said the plant can produce up to 60 megawatts of electricity.
